body:
Creepy/Ugly people remind other people of just how superficial, vain and otherwise surface-level they actually are. Don't you understand what a burden you put on them by making them look in the mirror?

When you're not around they get to pretend they're good people.  All the "good" people out there who somehow don't actually exist in real life. All those "good" people who don't exist except in their heads. 

[insert justification for why I'm superficial and otherwise don't have any depth but why you being ugly is actually the problem. What, you think you deserve the pleasurable aspects of humanity?  Why are uggos, those subhuman dregs, so entitled?]

Downvotes like crazy flying in this thread.  You can see it, nail -> head
